description:
Shots and time to kill through armour, per hit area. The damage calculator page's maths (https://rust.wiki/calculators/damage). Damage per hit = weapon damage x ammo
x attachment x hit-area multiplier x (1 - protection); protection of every piece covering the area is added (cap
100%), +4% per metal insert. Per zone (head, chest, legs, hands, feet): `protection_pct`, `damage_per_hit`,
`shots_to_kill` (null = never) and `time_to_kill_s` (fire rate plus reloads when the magazine runs out). Close
range only - no damage falloff; shotguns assume every pellet hits. Limb multipliers are low confidence.

ammo.description: Ammo name for that weapon (default: its standard ammo).

armour.description: Comma-separated armour and clothing the target wears (shortnames or names). Per slot: one clothing piece under one armour piece; dual pieces take both.

attachment.description: Muzzle attachment: none, silencer, oilfilter, sodacan, muzzlebrake.

inserts.description: Metal armour inserts per slot, `slot:n` (head, chest, legs, hands, feet; 0-3).

suit.description: Full-body suit instead: hazmatsuit or bone.armor.suit.

weapon.description: Weapon shortname or name (guns and bows).

name: calculate_damage
title: Shots and time to kill through armour, per hit area
